#### Intro:

+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Aims                              | - Ensure amnesia, hypnosis, immobility                                                     |
|                                   | - Prevent awareness (lower risk)                                                           |
|                                   | - Minimise CVS toxicity (higher risk)                                                      |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Problems                          | - Elderly                                                                                  |
|                                   | - Acutely unwell                                                                           |
|                                   | - Major surgery                                                                            |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Maintenance inhaled concentration | - After 15 mins, close to equilibration between inhaled, alveolar exhaled partial pressure |
|                                   | - Hence consider equivalent to MAC                                                         |
+-----------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Pharmacodynamics: age and illness

+---------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Values                          | - MAC-amnesia 0.25                                                           |
|                                 | - MAC-awake 0.33                                                             |
|                                 | - MAC (immobility) 1.0                                                       |
+---------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Factors reducing all MAC values | - Age: note quite linear ↓6% per decade after 40yrs (at 80: 1.4%)            |
|                                 | - Severe illness: mAP\<40mmHg, PaO~2~ \<40mmHg, PaCO~2~ \>80mmHg, ↓pH, ↓temp |
|                                 | - Adjuvant drugs: opioids, benzodiazepines                                   |
+---------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Effect of adjuvant opioid:

                       **Sevo alone**   **Sevo + fentanyl 3ng/mL**
  -------------------- ---------------- ----------------------------
  MACBAR               4.15%            ↓80%
  MAC                  1.85%            ↓60%
  MACawake (0.3)       0.6%             ↓25%
  Standard deviation   0.1              \<0.1

#### Volatile pharmacokinetics kinetics: age and illness

+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Absorption   | - ↓Cardiac output → ↑rate of rise F~A~/F~I~                                  |
+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Distribution | - ↓Cardiac output (↑age) → ↑rate of rise F~A~/F~I~                           |
|              | - ↓Muscle mass ↑rate of rise F~A~/F~I~                                       |
+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Metabolism   | - ↓Liver enzymatic activity → ↓rate of consumption → ↑rate of rise F~A~/F~I~ |
+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Excretion    | - N/A                                                                        |
+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Anaesthetic and surgical factors:

+------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| e.g. fractured NOF           | - Spinal anaesthetic→ ↓nociceptive activation of ARAS → ↓↓MAC requirement |
+------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| e.g. laparotomy, thoracotomy | - ↑↑Stimulation → ↑MAC requirement                                        |
+------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Answer:

+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Considerations | - Very low risk of awareness at 0.8 MAC = 1.1%              |
|                | - Significant reduction in MAC with age, illness, adjuvants |
|                | - Likely rapid ↑F~A~/F~I~                                   |
|                | - However need to account for ΔFA/FI                        |
+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Final answer   | - Inspired concentration 1.5%                               |
|                | - Recommend EEG monitoring e.g. BIS, aim 40-60              |
